turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Yes! Let me show you one example.
I walk my dog. She walks her dog.
The person is "she", so the verb gets -s: "walks".
Rule: after he, she or it, add -s to the verb.
Right: It sleeps on the bed. Wrong: It sleep on the bed.

Now your turn. Write only the verb:
My sister ___ (play) tennis on Sundays. (answer with only the verb)
